title: ervum unijugum
intro: Ervum unijugum, commonly known as horse gram or Madras gram, is a legume plant native to India and other parts of Asia. This plant has been traditionally used for its various health benefits, including its ability to lower blood sugar levels, aid in digestion, and help manage weight. The therapeutic actions of Ervum unijugum include its antidiabetic, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory properties, which may help to protect against chronic diseases such as diabetes and heart disease. The bioactive constituents of Ervum unijugum include proteins, fiber, and other phytochemicals, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions and health benefits.
